title: The new iPhone XS Max and Galaxy Note 9 are among the biggest, best, and most expensive phones you can buy — here's how they compare (AAPL)
text:
Sunday, 7 October 2018 ( 16 hours ago )
With the launch of the new iPhone XS Max, Apple is taking on Samsung's Galaxy Note 9.
The new extra-large iPhone has a big, beautiful OLED display, impressive battery life, and a high-end camera — much like the Note 9, which was introduced last month. Both phones cost more than $1,000, seemingly the new standard for high-end ... 👓 View full article
